chunks: Muḥammad ibn Muslim asked Abā Jaʿfar عليه السلام about dyeing, so he said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله used to dye, and this is his hair with us.

key_terms.أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ: Imam Muḥammad al-Bāqir عليه السلام, the one answering the question.
key_terms.الْخِضَابِ: Dyeing the hair with coloring substances.
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم.
key_terms.شَعْرُهُ: His hair, referring to the hair of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم.
key_terms.مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ: A prominent narrator who asks the Imam about the ruling or practice of dyeing.
key_terms.يَخْتَضِبُ: Used to apply dye to the hair.

ai.seo_question: Did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم dye his hair?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم used to dye his hair. Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام supports this by stating that some of the Prophet’s hair remained in their possession, indicating preservation of his trace and practice.
